entries.femaleVariant: I work in finance with the community accounts and I noticed something. People's debts are just zeroing out. They're not filing disputes or appeals. They're just gone.
entries.maleVariant: I work in finance with the community accounts and I noticed something. People's debts are just zeroing out. They're not filing disputes or appeals. They're just gone.

entries.femaleVariant: When a debtor dies, their account should freeze, but instead it's been clearing, like, immediately. I thought it was a glitch, but it's not. It's just happened too many times.
